response.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM rates) AS rate_ratio_to_mean FROM rates

assumptions.assumption: Bytes is cast to a real number before dividing, so the per-track ratio is not truncated by integer division.
The simple mean of rates covers only media types that have at least one matching track, because tracks without a match are dropped and media types with no tracks never appear in the grouped result.
Grouping is by media type name, as the request says 'for each media type name'.
